serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Shanice: Welcome back!
Shanice: Good news! My supply lines are working again so I can fix as many parts as you want!
You: That’s great to hear. The world is healing.
Shanice: Big part of the city is back to normal, but there are places that will stay destroyed for a long time. Some people just don’t have money for repairs.
You: Yeah, it sucks.
